No emitted magical power: she actively offers the disguised stone in the documented rescue ruse; overwhelming divine hierarchy, crown and lions convey might
Crete, site of her rescue of Zeus and worship; cavernous royal setting is editorial staging

aura: Documented Titan mother c01, mural crown/throne/two lions c21 and swaddled-stone rescue c05
artistic_choices: Square painterly walnut/antique-gold cinematic treatment, fully opaque garments; camera and tonal treatment are editorial.
Any symbolic divine scale is devotional composition, not an added claim of literal giant size; unspecified normal head/arm counts are restrained editorial rendering.
